_note: MAP for revenue-feud. C20. This file is the EDITORIAL half of board generation and it is maintained by hand — the CSV is the counts, this is the judgment. Three things live here because no script can derive them from survey responses: which raw answers MERGE into one board row (`from` takes a list), which are DROPPED as long tail (`drop`), and what each row is CALLED on the board (`label`). Column order here IS board order. A raw answer appearing in neither `from` nor `drop` is an ERROR, not a silent drop and not a silent new row: the generator stops and names it, so a survey that grows can never quietly change the board. Blank responses are never answers but DO count toward the denominator, matching the hand-entered original. Percentages are NOT stored here — they are computed.
